# Application pipeline

Generated from your saved application records. Edit the application record, then call Job Harness `rebuild_pipeline`; do not edit this view. This view does not check live job boards, email or calendars.

Recorded entries keep their last checked dates. Older notes may be stale; read the linked record before taking action. Applied can include direct requests or shared profiles, not just employer application confirmations. Proposed meeting times are not booked meetings.

| Stage | Records |
|---|---:|
| saved | 1 |
| prepared | 0 |
| applied | 1 |
| introduction | 1 |
| screening | 1 |
| technical | 2 |
| final | 0 |
| offer | 1 |
| closed | 1 |
| needs-review | 2 |

## Active conversations and interviews

| Role | Stage / scheduling | Next action | Booking route | Brief |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Example £ 😀 engineer](structured-a.md) | screening: proposed | Reply | verify résumé details | Email / no employer link saved | [Prep](briefs/brief.md) |
| [Example <script> product role](structured-b.md) | technical: 2026-01-03T11:00:00+00:00 | Attend verified synthetic booking | [Employer calendar](https://example.invalid/book) | Needed |
| [Example Research | Design](structured-c.md) | offer: unknown | Read terms before responding | Email / no employer link saved | Needed |
